aiu_storedHint: Switch on what you want to monitor. Subscriptions sign in with your own account; the entries below come from the admin's central credential storage (Settings → Credentials).
aiu_capClaude: Subscription — sign in once with your Claude account
aiu_capChatgpt: Subscription — sign in once with your ChatGPT account
aiu_capGemini: Subscription — sign in once with your Google account
aiu_claudeStep1: 1. Open the sign-in page and log in with your Claude account.
aiu_claudeStep2: 2. Copy the code shown there and redeem it here.
aiu_googleStep1: 1. Open the sign-in page and log in with your Google account.
aiu_googleStep2: 2. Copy the ENTIRE address from your browser's address bar and paste it here.
aiu_googleErrorPageHint: Your browser will then show an error page ("site cannot be reached") — that is expected. Google sends the result to your own computer, where nothing is listening. The address bar still contains the sign-in result, and that is what is needed here.

aiu_deviceWaiting: Waiting for your confirmation — this card updates by itself once you are done.
aiu_saveFirst: Save the settings first — then the sign-in can start.
aiu_instanceNotRunning: The instance is not running — start it to sign in.
aiu_noCredentials: No AI credentials stored yet — add them in the admin under Settings → Credentials.
aiu_adminKeyHint: This account needs an ADMIN key of your organisation, not the key the admin AI assistant uses. Personal accounts without an organisation cannot deliver usage reports.
